extDescription.message: Check your Steam inventory value and list items on the Steam Market in bulk. Runs in your browser; never reads your password.

popupIntro.message: Check what your Steam inventory is worth, then let us list the items you choose on the Steam Market. No password needed.

popupHow1.message: Sign in to Steam in this browser.

popupHow2.message: Open your order on steam.2cstudio.app and press "List with the extension".

popupHow3.message: Confirm the listings in the Steam Mobile app.

popupPrivacy.message: Runs only in your browser. We never see your Steam password or cookies.
